text_block_list.text: One day, someone indispensable to Tracen Academy was visiting the Director's office...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, regarding the repair locations for today...
Please see to the "library door," the "handrail on the second-floor stairs,"
and the "pedestal of the Three Goddesses statue."

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Gahahaha! You really went all out this time!
Now that's what gets my blood pumping!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
My sincerest apologies! I'm always so grateful...!
Thank you for accommodating my schedule!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat it, it's the Chairwoman and me we're talking about! Feel free to keep leaning heavily on us whenever facilities need repairs!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Ain't it completely natural in the first place?
This is an academy for Umamusume, after all!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
First off, their physical builds are just built different.
Every single one of them has strength to spare.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text: When girls are taught to sharpen their fighting spirit for races and that hallways are meant for sprinting—it's inevitable that things get broken! Even if not on purpose!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text: Some kids break things by takin' pranks too far, and some just don't know their own strength. Hell, I hear there's even one who keeps breakin' fences and fixin' 'em over and over!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
"Still, don't you worry. That's exactly why we're here—
Umanari Construction at your service!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm always relying on you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Just one point. Regarding the repairs on the wall behind the school building,
"she" has kindly offered to take care of it,
so please just keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Alright, back to work, back to work... Oh, hey!
If it isn't little miss Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
So you're the little lady they asked to do the job here after all.
How about it? Care to let us handle that part for you too while we're at it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No.
This is my job, after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If I accepted the job,
I have to see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, could you check this for me?
To see if I did the surface preparation right...

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Leave it to me! They don't call me a "demon for work" for nothing—I'll give them some strict feedback...!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
"...A uniform finish with no unevenness.
The mortar mixing ratio is perfect, too—yep."

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text: It's work that you can charge money for.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Did I pass?

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Passed? You aced it! An overwhelming pass!
I wish my own apprentice would take a page out of your book.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Well, no wonder the Chairwoman relies on you so much...
I saw it, you know? Your work the other dayâ

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
At first I thought another contractor did it,
but word has it the little lady did that one too.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. Mind if I ask you something?
How are you able to do such great work?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Not really.
I'm just doing it, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
No, no! You're being too modest!
Your work is filled with soul, young lady!
A steadfast pride, and the grit to see it through!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
This is the work of someone who takes "pride" in their craft.
It's not something just anyone can do.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
…………My grandpa.
When it comes to my grandpa's work...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—She has a sense of “self.”
She doesn't just do things because she was told to...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: For my own sake. Staying true to my ideals. And that ended up exceeding what was expected of me—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That's what I want to do, too.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you got me there. Whew.
So this is what it means to straighten up one's spine.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, little lady. You interested in civil engineering
at all? If you've got even the slightest bit of interest—"

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Knock on the door of 'Umanari Construction'. Got it?
'Umanari Construction', okay? It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'll keep that in mind.

One day, I saw Believe surrounded by tools behind
the school building. When I asked her about it—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Which is why I've been working since noon. All that's left now is waiting for the paint to dry.
choice_data_list: Getting praised by a pro— that's amazing!
Getting praised by a pro— that's amazing, huh!
Whoa! It's fixed up so nicely!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Which is why I've been working since noon. All that's left now is waiting for the paint to dry.
choice_data_list: Getting praised by a pro— that's amazing!
Getting praised by a pro— that's amazing, huh!
Whoa! It's fixed up so nicely!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No.
I still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Earlier, the master craftsman showed me
his work, but..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: She's not just thorough. She's fast, and she knows exactly where to invest her time...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I need to follow their example.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I had a hard time figuring out the mortar mix.
I had to redo it quite a few times..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Since it took quite a bit of time,
I suppose it's only natural that it worked out.
choice_data_list: Still, it's amazing that you fixed it so perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Because that's my job.
